sources.title: Capital guidance 2026/27 to 2029/30
sources.facts: Sets capital-planning expectations, including developer contributions and collaboration with local planning authorities.
sources.guard: Capital guidance does not prove a project has an allocation, business-case approval, planning consent or delivery.

sources.title: Guidance on developing a 10-year infrastructure strategy
sources.facts: Supports integrated care systems assessing estate, digital, equipment, investment and sustainability requirements.
sources.guard: Strategy guidance does not prove local need, site availability, funding, acquisition, approval or construction.

sources.title: Integrated care system infrastructure strategy
sources.facts: Explains the requirement for system-wide 10-year infrastructure strategies aligned with clinical and national priorities.
sources.guard: A programme requirement does not prove a local strategy is complete, funded, adopted or deliverable.

sources.title: Estates technical guidance
sources.facts: Collects health building notes, technical memoranda, bulletins, procurement, net-zero and assurance guidance.
sources.guard: A technical collection does not prove every document applies or a facility complies with all standards.

sources.title: Health building notes
sources.facts: Provides best-practice planning and design guidance for new, adapted and extended healthcare buildings.
sources.guard: Design guidance does not prove a scheme meets clinical need, regulation, infection control, cost or approval requirements.

sources.title: Health Building Note 00-01: General design guidance for healthcare buildings
sources.facts: Sets general design and future-proofing considerations for healthcare capital projects.
sources.guard: General design principles do not prove a particular design is safe, compliant, commissioned or approved.

sources.title: Health Building Note 00-08: Strategic framework for the efficient management of healthcare estates and facilities
sources.facts: Covers active management of health land and buildings, including acquisition, disposal and town-planning considerations.
sources.guard: Estate-management guidance does not prove ownership, surplus status, disposal, purchase, valuation or planning outcome.

sources.title: 10 Year Capital Plan for Health and Social Care
sources.facts: Sets long-term health and social-care capital direction and identifies a revised Estatecode expected in autumn 2026.
sources.guard: A national capital plan or future framework does not prove a local project, allocation, timetable or outcome.
